purpose: Close the frozen n>=10 Taiwan orientation-niche coverage gate with source-backed published vouchers, rerun the six-topology present-day PGLS, and rerun the branchwise transition-niche diagnostic with executable source.

voucher_augmentation.selection_rule: All eligible source-backed vouchers were screened before the frozen 0.05-degree cell thinning; an existing guarded GBIF record wins a cell tie.

chelsa_bio15.direction: D taxa have higher present-day precipitation seasonality centroids

chelsa_bio01.direction: D taxa have lower present-day annual mean temperature centroids

pgls_11_taxa_across_six_topologies.interpretation: The previously threshold-sensitive BIO15/BIO1 terminal association now passes the frozen n>=10 primary screen on all six retained topologies. This remains a present-day taxon-centroid association.

branchwise_method_recovery.note: Directional shifts and expected-transition ranges reproduce v1 numerically. Exact v1 permutation p-values cannot be regenerated because v1 did not record its RNG seed or executable implementation.

chelsa_bio15.direction: U_to_D aligned with higher precipitation seasonality

chelsa_bio01.direction: U_to_D aligned with lower annual mean temperature

branchwise_11_taxa_across_six_topologies.decision: Coverage was the predeclared discriminator and is now closed. Retain the topology-stable directions, but do not promote either axis to repeated niche-associated convergence and do not add occurrences merely to chase significance.

claim_boundary: The 11-taxon result supports topology-robust present-day BIO15/BIO1 orientation associations, not ancestral niche states, historical range, absolute event timing, same-voucher orientation, parallel/convergent adaptation, fitness effects or ecological causation.
